homeSection.title: I build awesome web and mobile applications, with a focus on user experience

canal-plus.desc: A web application monitoring the internet connection of Canal+ customers.
canal-plus.context: As a fullstack consultant at Ippon Technologies, I collaborated with Canal+ for a full-remote frontend position.
canal-plus.concept:
Canal+ provides internet services in french overseas.
The mission consisted of supporting their frontend team to develop and maintain their monitoring application used by support and technical teams.

I developed a new auto-diagnostic feature aimed at speeding up the support process for support teams. This module provides real-time analysis of a user's internet connection, using websockets directly retrieving data from equipments.

bento.desc: A fullstack application dedicated to company tools and resources.
bento.context: Master's degree internship project at Ippon Technologies.
bento.concept: A web agency platform aimed at developing an interactive application to centralize the company's resources and tools. The web app features Google OAuth integration, a masonry grid layout, and plugin creation capabilities. The design, inspired by the iOS home layout, was made using Figma with a focus on making a pleasant user-experience.

blindspot.desc: An IOT belt prototype to help visually impaired people.
blindspot.context: Master's degree final project aiming at developing a tech solution with a positive societal impact, addressing environmental or social concerns. The team comprised eight members from various EPITECH campuses across France.
blindspot.concept: An IoT solution for visually impaired individuals: a connected belt equipped with a Raspberry Pi, cameras, and vibration motors. Using pattern recognition, the vibration motors indicate the direction and distance of obstacles around the user. Additionally, a mobile application developed with Flutter provides information about the belt, such as battery level and emergency call functionality.

safecheck.desc: A mobile application to authenticate sneakers with AI.
safecheck.context: Entrepreneurship training in Artificial Intelligence, offered in partnership with EPITECH IT School and EMLyon Business School. Over four months, participants had to identify a current challenge and develop a viable entrepreneurial solution leveraging artificial intelligence.
safecheck.concept:
Addressing the growing issue of counterfeit products in the fashion industry, we developed a mobile application that authenticates sneakers using photographs.

My team and I created a dataset of counterfeit and authentic sneaker images, which we used to train an AI model using scikit-learn. I then developed a React Native mobile application that allows users to input pictures and output an authentication result.
